context: 2. DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION The recommended dose for CASODEX therapy in combination with an LHRH analog is one 50 mg tablet once daily (morning or evening), with or without food. It is recommended that CASODEX be taken at the same time each day. Treatment
2. DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION 3. DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS CASODEX ® (bicalutamide) 50 mg tablets for oral administration.
